title: Bifold Poly Track Insert
description: The Bifold Poly Track Insert is a durable polymer component designed to fit within the track of bifold door systems, providing a smooth, low-friction surface for rollers and carriers.
longDescription: The Bifold Poly Track Insert is engineered to enhance the performance and longevity of bifold door systems by offering a resilient, low-wear running surface. Constructed from high-quality polymer, this insert is designed to minimize noise and friction, ensuring that door panels glide smoothly and quietly along the track. Easy to install, the Poly Track Insert also helps protect the underlying track from wear and damage, making it a valuable addition for both new installations and retrofits in residential or commercial settings.
features: High-quality polymer construction for durability and reduced wear
Minimizes friction and allows smooth, quiet door panel movement
Protects aluminium or metal track surfaces from scratches and damage

Suitable for both residential and commercial applications, this channel ensures the integrity and smooth operation of sliding or folding systems.
